dedupe_keys.name: oil drilling pipe and coupling gap annotated images

description: The current Mendeley deposit contains one data.zip archive of about 204 megabytes with images of oil-well drill pipes and coupling gaps. Repository metadata describe 500 masked pipe images and 500 corresponding gap images with text annotations produced using Labelme in a YOLOv11-compatible format. The article states that original industrial images came from Hubei Jianghan Petroleum Instrument in China and describes a cascaded detector as a study result. Mendeley states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the dataset. These labels can test a drilling-operation perception component, but the deposit does not publish the trained detector as a separate verified model resource. One image source, chosen capture conditions and manual masks are limitations for field deployment. A reviewer-assessed use is checking whether an equipment-state pipeline detects coupling gaps before an oil-field operations simulation uses that state. data-dsdpm66-coal-mine-drilling-operations-image-dataset is a related drilling imagery resource from another setting. No image archive or model code was downloaded. Coverage is the annotated pipe imagery from one industrial collection.
